name: Greek Pork Chops with Zucchini, Tomatoes and Feta
ingredients_verbatim: 4 pork chops loin or center cut, bone in or boneless, 1 inch thick, 6-8 oz each
2-4 teaspoons oregano, dried more or less to taste
2 cups grape or cherry tomatoes, halved approximately
why: Mediterranean pork-chop skillet, a cuisine gap in a catalog that skews American/Tex-Mex and a flavor angle no existing pork-chop candidate covers (all the current ones are creamy/cheese/mushroom pan-sauce variants). Published nutrition sits dead-center of the band: 482 cal, 37g protein, 9g carbs. Structurally low-carb - pork over non-starchy zucchini and tomatoes with olives and feta, no rice/pasta/potato. Every ingredient maps to the board (pork-chops, olive-oil, garlic, dried-oregano, chicken-broth, zucchini, cherry-tomatoes, black-olives, feta). Batch-scales cleanly by weigh-and-divide. Nutrition read directly from the recipe card, high confidence.
